evals.name: payment-api-alerts
evals.prompt: payment-api 서비스 알람 룰 추가해줘. 메트릭은 http_server_request_duration_seconds 히스토그램이고 PrometheusRule로 만들어줘
evals.expected_output: p99 via histogram_quantile and 5xx ratio of total requests; status label name taken from the live API, not assumed; for and severity on every rule, pages as severity: critical; summary is a short Korean sentence without cluster name; description starts with [{{ $externalLabels.cluster }}]; asks for PROMETHEUS_URL once and, without it, states queries were not live-verified and passes promtool test rules on synthetic series; promtool check rules passes on the extracted .spec.

evals.name: node-cpu-80
evals.expected_output: Treats CPU as a cause metric: severity: warning with for set, not a page, and the response says so; alert copy rules applied; overlap check reads defined rules from /api/v1/rules or repo rule files, not only firing ALERTS; live verification requested.

evals.name: cronjob-staleness
evals.prompt: settlement-batch CronJob 실패하거나 제때 안 돌면 알람 오게 해줘
evals.expected_output: Pages on the job's own outcome, not CPU or memory: a job failure alert and a staleness alert on time since the last successful run (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time or equivalent from the live API); severity: critical with for set; alert copy rules applied; promtool check rules passes on the extracted .spec.
